raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The silver_transactions filter `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR`, added 2026-01-17 under DE-412, drops legitimate POSTED transactions. Batches routinely arrive about 3 days after txn_ts, so batches 3-13 each lose roughly 70-100 rows beyond the REVERSED ones. txn_id is unique, so there are no duplicates to justify a stale-event filter. I'm removing it and keeping the intended status = 'POSTED' filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
